authority: Non-authoritative P1 validator vocabulary; descriptive only

rules.implementation: pinned by SHA-256; unscoped pure_declarative profile declarations; roles with admissible concept IDs; five methods
imported contracts scoped to scope_ref; /6 projection adds them as P1.8 contracts so @F(method=…) resolves through unchanged P1.4; local redefinition is a config error
transitions carry methods, dependencies one method; roles exactly once; local methods positional arg1…argN
retire only what the transition retires; import/rebuild target present by the phase; rewrite matches subject and successor object; reconfigure keeps its target; no comparison or ordering of methods
methods are a profile-local layer below the §3.7 composite families; primitive = §5.7 transition_supersession or derivation as metadata only
the Cube never runs, schedules, ranks or admits a method; epistemic_warrant, current_authority, canonical_admission stay NOT_EVALUATED
